items.title: NSF Supports AI, Cybersecurity Training at 14 Universities - GovTech
items.summary: ## The National Science Foundation will award funding to 14 universities through its CyberAICorps program to develop both public- and private-sector expertise in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Fourteen higher education institutions will receive new funding to prepare students for careers at the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, the National Science Foundation (NSF) announced today. The foundation’s CyberAICorps Scholarship for Service (CyberAI SFS) program will fund university programs that integrate AI and cybersecurity education, workforce training and career pathways to state, local and federal government jobs that address national security needs. A news release from NSF said the funded universities will develop or maintain programs that combine technical training with hands-on experience, including research opportunities, cyber laboratories, virtual training environments, internships and partnerships with government and industry. As an example of the Scholarship Track, Vanderbilt University received $2,449,463 for a doctoral program that will support research on trustworthy AI, AI-enabled cyber defense and agentic AI systems.

items.title: Nasdaq slumps on worsening chipmaker rout as AI bubble, China competition concerns mount - New York Post
items.summary: A tech and chip stock rout deepened Tuesday as mounting fears around a potential AI bubble and concerns that China’s own technology is catching up pushed investors toward other sectors. “Wednesday may be the most important day for markets in recent memory as [Federal Reserve] Chair Warsh will have an opportunity to update investors on the prospects of a rate hike given rising oil prices, and big tech earnings may help shed light on whether or not we are finally seeing a return on investment for the massive amounts of AI spending taking place,” Rick Gardner, chief investment officer at RGA Investments, said in a note Tuesday. Weeks earlier, Chinese startup Z.ai introduced an AI model that is nearly as advanced as Anthropic’s ultra-powerful Fable and Mythos – and it has already landed on a leaderboard of the world’s 10 most popular bots.

July 28 (Reuters) - More than 1,100 employees from leading tech firms on Tuesday urged the U.S. government to support ​an international effort to develop tools for managing the pace ‌of advanced AI development. *   The initiative, called Pacing the Frontier, includes employees from ​Meta Platforms (META.O), opens new tab, Anthropic, OpenAI and Alphabet's (GOOGL.O), opens new tab Google, with support ⁠from nonprofits Guidelight AI Standards and Encode AI. *   "We request that the ​U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance ​tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," the statement said. *   Responding to the statement, ​OpenAI posted on X: "We believe that, at some point in the future, AI acceleration ‌for ⁠frontier model development may be so high that the world will need to pace the rate of AI advancement.". items.title: Trump administration bans new Chinese robots and inverters from US production and imports - Межа. Новини України.
items.summary: ### Polish foundation buys five used buses in Kielce to send to Vinnytsia. The Trump administration officially announced the imposition of a ban on the production and import of new Chinese robots and inverters in the United States, calling it part of a strategy to strengthen national security and support the development of artificial intelligence in the country. The government points to the need to reduce dependence on external links in key technologies in order to preserve and strengthen the United States’ leadership in artificial intelligence and autonomous systems. They say this will push the market to turn to alternative suppliers in the United States and its allies, and will accelerate the development of local solutions and US-based manufacturers of inverters and components for robotics. The ban on the import and use of new Chinese robots and inverters is viewed as part of a broader U.S. strategy to protect critically important technologies and support leadership in artificial intelligence.

items.title: 4 cổ phiếu Mỹ có báo cáo lợi nhuận đáng chú ý tuần này: Liệu chi tiêu cho AI có thực sự mang lại hiệu quả?
items.summary:
Lockridge Okoth là nhà báo và chuyên gia phân tích kỹ thuật tại BeInCrypto, chuyên đưa tin về những diễn biến lớn của thị trường tài sản số, DeFi, NFT, GameFi, tài sản thực RWAs và các công nghệ blockchain nói chung. Những lĩnh vực mà anh quan tâm còn mở rộng sang chứng khoán, các kênh trú ẩn an toàn như vàng và bạc. [...] Sự chênh lệch này cho thấy lợi ích chưa thực sự xuất hiện ngay. Tuy nhiên, tín hiệu nhu cầu cho thấy kết quả khả quan vẫn còn phía trước, và con số tồn đọng 627 tỷ USD của Microsoft là lý do thuyết phục nhất để giữ kiên nhẫn.

Việc các nhà đầu tư có tiếp tục kiên nhẫn hay không sẽ phụ thuộc vào dự báo của bốn công ty này cho năm 2027, chứ không phải vào lợi nhuận mà họ đạt được trong quý vừa qua. Thị trường hiện tại cũng đang đặt dấu hỏi về chất lượng doanh thu từ AI. [...] Dữ kiện trước đây cho thấy phản ứng có thể trái chiều. Ngày 30/04, Alphabet tăng hơn 300 tỷ USD vốn hóa, như BeInCrypto đã đưa tin. Trong cùng phiên, Meta bốc hơi 175 tỷ USD. Cả hai đều vượt kỳ vọng về doanh thu, chỉ khác ở dự báo chi tiêu sắp tới.

Thị trường quyền chọn dự báo cổ phiếu Amazon sẽ biến động khoảng 6.3% trong ngày công bố kết quả, cao hơn mức trung bình gần đây. Ba công ty còn lại cũng được dự đoán sẽ biến động mạnh tương tự.
